meta.title: Mesopotamia Song | Grade 3 History for Kids | Little Takhti
meta.description: Sing along with Takhti and travel back to Mesopotamia, the land between the rivers! Learn about the Tigris and Euphrates, some of the first cities built with mud bricks, cuneiform writing pressed into clay tablets, the wheel, the plough and the ziggurat. Then shout the answers in the quiz.
